list.title: Fan into Flame the Gift of God
A Good Soldier of Christ Jesus
Terrible Times in the Last Days and the God-Breathed Scriptures

findings.problem: This passage crosses a natural turn at 2 Timothy 3:10. Verses 1-9 describe the evil people of the last days and tell Timothy to turn away from them. At “You, however,” Paul contrasts Timothy with those people, recalls his own example and sufferings, and calls Timothy to continue in the God-breathed Scriptures in verses 10-17. These are two distinct steps of the argument, and each has enough material to stand as its own passage.

rule.text: Break at natural turns: a new scene (the place, the time or the people change), a new speaker or speech, a new psalm, or the end of one argument and the start of the next.
